goal: Prove original RGBA PNG binary bytes can be transferred through a GitHub/shared channel with independent downstream readback; no animal art.
scope: Generate exactly one tiny synthetic RGBA PNG in code
Compute raw SHA256, byte size, PNG signature, IHDR, channel/alpha data
Upload true binary via available API (NOT UTF-8 text create_file) and commit immutable reference if feasible
Publish machine-readable receipt including channel, commit, Git blob SHA, true binary SHA256 and exact download route
If connector cannot provide receiver-downloadable binary bytes, mark BINARY_TRANSPORT_BLOCKED and record evidence/feasible alternative without claiming PASS
acceptance: ART in independent work page independently retrieves and hashes/decodes same original bytes before marking PASS_BINARY_EXCHANGE. DEV-only upload is not PASS.
